source.title: HeyPCB ESP32-S3 LDR - GL5528 photoresistor light sensor
source.fabrication_status: source README says not fabricated, assembled, or powered
source.original_board_firmware: none found for this board in the pinned source

sensor_network.evidence: pad nets read from the pinned PCB blob; values and MPNs from the pinned BOM blob

elements.note: ideal source; U2 AP2112K-3.3 is not modeled

elements.value: 15 kΩ at 10 lx, routed power law

probe.evidence: board.json maps U3 pin 39 to SNS_AN1; README says SNS_AN1 is on IO1

photoresistor_data.document: GL55 Series CdS Photoresistor Manual, SENBA OPTICAL & ELECTRONIC CO.,LTD., 6 pages

definitions.gamma: Lg(R10/R100) / Lg(100/10), with R10 and R100 the resistances under 10 lx and 100 lx
definitions.light_resistance: irradiated by 400-600 lx for two hours, then tested at 10 lx under standard light source A (2856 K)
definitions.dark_resistance: resistance ten seconds after the 10 lx light is shut off

parameter_notes: r_ref_ohms is the midpoint of the 10-20 kΩ range; the manual gives no typical value.
The gamma definition spans 10-100 lx. The 1-10 lx part of the modeled range follows the straight band of the manual's Fig. 3 and is an assumption.
The board BOM names LCSC C10081. On 2026-11-19 the LCSC listing for C10081 named JCHL as manufacturer with 8-20 kΩ and gamma 0.65; those seller parameters differ from this manual and are not used.
LabWired Part Knowledge returned NOT_FOUND for GL5528 on 2026-11-19; these values are not cross-checked facts in that corpus.
